titleEn: Final Prices With a Special Discount in a Shop
title: 商品折扣后的最终价格
summary: 每件商品折扣为其右侧第一个价格不高于它的商品价格，若不存在则不打折，返回最终价格。
insight: 维护尚未找到折扣且价格递增的下标栈；新价格不高于栈顶价格时，它就是栈顶商品的首个折扣。
pitfalls: 折扣条件是小于或等于
同一新价格可能为多个旧商品提供折扣
直接在结果数组上减去折扣

solutions.title: 下一个不大于元素单调栈
solutions.idea: 用新元素结算所有价格不低于它的待处理商品。
steps: 扫描 i；while 栈非空且 prices[top]>=prices[i]，answer[top]-=prices[i] 并弹出
把 i 入栈，返回 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int[] finalPrices(int[] prices){int[] answer=prices.clone();Deque<Integer> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int i=0;i<prices.length;i++){while(!stack.isEmpty()&&prices[stack.peek()]>=prices[i])answer[stack.pop()]-=prices[i];stack.push(i);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun finalPrices(prices:IntArray):IntArray{val answer=prices.copyOf();val stack=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();for(i in prices.indices){while(stack.isNotEmpty()&&prices[stack.peek()]>=prices[i])answer[stack.pop()]-=prices[i];stack.push(i)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> finalPrices(vector<int>& prices){vector<int> answer=prices,stack;for(int i=0;i<(int)prices.size();++i){while(!stack.empty()&&prices[stack.back()]>=prices[i]){answer[stack.back()]-=prices[i];stack.pop_back();}stack.push_back(i);}return answer;} };
